newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Europe bunkers soften, ARA enquiries still high.
newsitem.headline: Europe bunkers soften, ARA enquiries still high.

text.p: European bunker prices mostly softened on Thursday, the weakness leading to good buying in ARA, but little elsewhere, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst was at around $126 fob after the barge market weakened by some $3 a tonne.
Business throughout the ARA region was also reasonably healthy with the appearance of 20,000-25,000 tonnes of enquiries.
"After a dreadful September, we're finally seen some decent volumes this month," one supplier said.
A few enquiries emerged, but total volume was slight.
Bunkers in Mediterranean ports were generally softer. French prices were down $1. In Spain, fuel oil was $2 weaker. Only Istanbul and Piraeus gained, by $1 a tonne.
Many ports experienced good buying early in the week, but that had faded in most areas
Fujairah bunkers were little changed, but bids did come off $1 to $115, in the hope that a softer Singapore market might impact further west.
Durban fuel oil lost about $3 a tonne to $127/$128 ex-wharf.
